Deposit holds typically last 2–7 business days, depending on the reason for the hold [6]. You'll be notified of any hold through your deposit receipt, ATM screen, email, or mail, depending on how you deposited the check [7].

If you'd prefer to avoid holds altogether, ask the person or business paying you to use electronic payment methods like direct deposit, ACH payments, wire transfers, or Zelle® instead—these are typically available the same day [4].
